title: NBA: Sixers roll on to down Pistons, Knicks gore Bulls
summary: Jaylen Brown and Joel Embiid combined for 56 points as the Philadelphia 76ers defeated the Detroit Pistons, 112-106, in their heavyweight top-of-the-table NBA Eastern Conference clash on Wednesday.
